name: secret-guard
description: Masks secrets in tool results and blocks writing or committing them.

maskResults.title: Mask secrets in tool results
maskResults.description: Hide secrets in what Read, Bash and other tools return to the model.

onWrite.title: When a write would hold a secret
onWrite.description: block refuses the write; warn shows a notice and lets it through.

guardCommits.title: Check staged changes before git commit
guardCommits.description: Refuse git commit when the staged changes hold a secret.

extraAllowedFiles.title: Extra files allowed to hold secrets
extraAllowedFiles.description: Regular expressions for file paths, comma separated. Files named .env are always allowed. Example: secrets\.yaml$,\.local\.json$
